items.name: Malta National Aquarium
items.area: Qawra Point (~10-min walk from AX ODYCY)
items.address: Triq It-Trunciera, Qawra, St Paul's Bay
items.hours: Daily 10:00–20:00 (official site, 9 Oct 2026); daily talk programme (sharks 10:30, main tank 13:00/16:00, octopus 14:30, reptiles 15:00, big fish 17:00)
items.price_range: Adult (13+): €17.90 door / €16.90 online; child (4–12): €11.90/€10.90; senior (60+): €14.90/€13.90; after-4pm adult online €13.90; annual pass adult €45
items.description: The islands' only aquarium: starfish-shaped complex on Qawra Point, 50+ tanks, ~300 species, 12-m main tank with walk-through tunnel, ray touch pool, reptile zone. 45–90 min visit. Next door to Café del Mar Malta.
items.notes: Prices/hours read directly from the official tickets page 9 Oct 2026 (earlier third-party guides listed €13.50–16.90 adult — superseded by the official door/online prices). Heritage Malta Multisite Pass includes the aquarium (see act-multisite-pass).

items.name: St Paul's Islands & harbour boat trips from Qawra/Buġibba
items.area: Qawra / Buġibba / St Paul's Bay
items.address: Departures from Buġibba & Qawra (and Sliema for some operators)
items.hours: Operator-dependent; October day trips still running, weather-dependent
items.price_range: Comino/Blue Lagoon day trips from ~€20–35 (CheckYeti/TripAdvisor listings); sunset cruises ~€30–36; 3-islands trips ~€30
items.description: Short boat trips to St Paul's Islands (the traditional landing site of St Paul) and day trips to Comino's Blue Lagoon operate from the Buġibba/Qawra harbours — the classic north-coast add-on to an aquarium morning.
items.notes: Operators and price ranges from CheckYeti/TripAdvisor activity listings (2026) — third-party marketplaces, not operator pages; prices unverified with operators. Book on the day after checking the wind/sea forecast.

items.name: Beaches near the hotel (Qawra Point & Buġibba, Salina Bay, Golden Bay/Għajn Tuffieħa)
items.area: Qawra / St Paul's Bay / Mellieħa
items.address: Qawra Point Beach (Bugibba), Salina Bay salt pans, Golden Bay & Għajn Tuffieħa (Mellieħa)
items.hours: Beaches unstaffed in October (lifeguards off-season); sea ~23 °C (estimate)
items.description: Qawra Point/Bugibba's rocky bays are a 5–10 min walk from the hotel; Salina Bay's salt pans are a flat scenic walk; Golden Bay and Għajn Tuffieħa are the island's best sandy beaches (~20–30 min by bus: 223 toward Golden Bay from Buġibba; 41/42 from Valletta).
items.notes: Beach set from hubpymalta's St Paul's Bay guide (Jan 2026) and maltatravelguides (May 2026, 223 Golden Bay; 31/41/45 corridors); sea temperature is a climate estimate (see data/everyday.json). October: quieter bays, still swimmable.

items.name: Xemxija & St Paul's Bay heritage shore
items.area: Xemxija / St Paul's Bay
items.address: Xemxija (between St Paul's Bay and Mistra Bay)
items.hours: Outdoor, always open
items.description: Xemxija's coastal walk (Roman baths remains, seafront promenade) and Mistra Bay — a gentle, free, walkable heritage option between Buġibba and Mellieħa, reachable on foot from St Paul's Bay or by bus 221/222.
items.notes: General description from hubpymalta's St Paul's Bay guide (Jan 2026) — guidebook consensus; no single load-bearing source.

items.name: Mosta Rotunda (Church of St Mary)
items.area: Mosta (~10 min from Qawra on bus 186, Mosta Rotunda stop)
items.address: Mosta
items.hours: Church hours not captured — confirm locally
items.price_range: Small admission (museum section) — price not verified
items.description: One of Europe's largest unsupported domes (45 m interior), famous for the WWII bomb that pierced it without exploding. The closest big sight to your hotel — the 186 passes the Rotunda stop.
items.notes: Carried from landmarks.html (24 Sep 2026): admission charge 'not verified' — flag kept. Bus 186 Mosta Rotunda stop per malta.busatlas.uk Nov 2025 timetable (9 Oct 2026 read).

items.name: CDM Sundays at Café del Mar Malta (Sun 18 Oct — FREE)
items.area: Café del Mar, Qawra Point (~10-min walk from the hotel)
items.address: Triq it-Trunċiera, Qawra SPB 1500
items.hours: Sundays, from late afternoon into the night (venue open daily 10:00–00:00; October sessions run to ~01:00)
items.price_range: FREE on 18 Oct 2026 (Oct Sundays 4/11/18/25 listed free; some dates €10–15)
items.description: The weekly Sunday open-air session at Malta's most iconic seaside venue — DJ sets, sofas, sunset drinks, right next to the aquarium. 18 Oct is Grand Final day, so this is your between-sessions / same-evening option without leaving the neighbourhood.
items.notes: sundays.com.mt (the venue's own event site) lists 18 October as a free CDM Sundays date, read 9 Oct 2026. Spotlightmalta corroborates the weekly Sunday series. Grand Final timing unpublished — check the TWC format page before planning the overlap.

items.name: Heritage Malta Multisite Pass (incl. Malta National Aquarium)
items.area: All Heritage Malta sites incl. the aquarium
items.address: Buy via Heritage Malta sites/store
items.hours: Valid 30 days from first use
items.description: Covers the Malta National Aquarium, Ħaġar Qim & Mnajdra, Inquisitor's Palace, National Museum of Archaeology, National War Museum, Domvs Romana, St Paul's Catacombs, Tarxien, Għar Dalam, Ċittadella Visitors' Centre and more. Excludes the Hypogeum and Valletta Underground.
items.notes: Exact pass prices read from the aquarium's official tickets page 9 Oct 2026 (resolves the 24 Sep flag 'exact adult price within the €30–60 band not captured' — adult = €60.00). Break-even vs singles: St John's is independent; aquarium €16.90 online + 3–4 HM sites ≈ pass territory.

items.name: Weather in your window (13–19 Oct 2026)
items.area: Island-wide
items.description: Mid-October: typically ~20–24 °C days, cooler evenings; sea still ~23–24 °C; rain possible but not the norm. Pack a light layer for evenings + sunscreen for south-coast sights; October sea is still swimmable.
items.notes: Climate normals from TUI/Sunheron (carried from everyday.html, 23 Sep 2026) — estimates, not a forecast; check a forecast (e.g. the Malta Meteorological Office / weather apps) in the week before travel.
